intro: Sign in with your phone number to continue your process.
phoneHint: Include your country code, for example +52.
verifyIntro: Enter the six-digit code sent to your phone.
pickIntro: This phone has several workers. Choose your name to see only your information.
sessionReady: Your identity is selected. Your information and actions are stored separately from other workers.
logoutHint: Your pending actions are kept when you sign out.
unavailable: The application is not available right now.
runtimeError: Storage could not be opened. Close and reopen the application.

errors.invalid_phone: Enter a valid phone number with its country code.
errors.invalid_otp: Check the six-digit code and try again.
errors.network: Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
errors.secure_storage: Your session could not be securely saved or removed. Try again before continuing.
errors.worker_forbidden: This identity is not available. Sign in again.
errors.reauthenticate: Your session expired. Sign in again; your pending actions are kept.
errors.invalid_response: The response could not be verified. Try again.
errors.request_unavailable: Wait for the operation to finish and try again.
errors.generic: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
errors.sync_unavailable: Your saved actions are kept. Synchronization is unavailable; try again when connected.
errors.local_data_error: Could not read saved data. Try again.
errors.save_failed: Could not save confirmation. Try again.
errors.refresh_failed: Could not refresh. Try again when connected.
errors.language_failed: Could not save the language. Try again.
errors.document_save_failed: The document was not saved. Try again; keep the preview open.
errors.capture_camera_denied: Allow camera access in settings or choose an image.
errors.capture_selection_failed: Could not open the image. Choose another or try the camera again.
errors.capture_compression_failed: Could not prepare the image. Retake the photo or choose another.
errors.upload_too_large: The image must be below 1.5 MB. Choose another photo.
errors.capture_save_failed: No new submission was saved. Check Documents and choose a photo again.
errors.capture_selection_changed: The worker or document changed. Return to Documents to start again.
errors.capture_cleanup_failed: Image cleanup could not finish. Return to Documents and retry; pending uploads are kept.
errors.local_file_missing: The saved image is missing. Take a new photo to replace this submission.
errors.local_file_changed: The saved image changed. Take another photo to replace this submission.
errors.file_ownership_invalid: This image cannot be used for this worker. Choose a photo again.
errors.capture_settings_failed: Could not open settings. Open them from the system or choose an image.
errors.local_file_unreadable: The saved image cannot be read. Choose a new photo to replace the submission.
errors.capture_storage_failed: Could not store the image. Free storage on the phone and choose a photo again.

configurationError: The service connection is not configured. Contact the support team.

home.title: Home
home.refreshPending: Update pending. Your saved data remains available.
home.refreshFailed: Could not update. Saved data is shown; try again when connected.
home.assignmentFact: Job assignment available on this phone.
home.documentsUnavailable: The documents screen is not available yet.
home.offline: Offline · your actions are saved on this phone
home.noData: Could not load your assignment. Refresh or try again later.
home.noOfflineData: No assignment is saved yet. Connect to download your data.
home.documentsAvailable: View requirements, review status and corrections.

terms.reconfirm: The terms have changed. Review this version and confirm again if you agree.
terms.updateRequired: This version was rejected as outdated. Connect and refresh to review the current terms.
terms.pendingHint: Your confirmation is saved on this phone. The server has not acknowledged it yet.
terms.failedHint: Submission failed. Review these terms and confirm again to create a new submission. Refreshing alone does not resend it.
terms.staleHistory: Confirmation of {{version}} was rejected after an update; it did not confirm newer versions.
terms.replaceFailed: Confirm {{version}} again and replace failed submission

documents.captureUnavailable: Photo capture will be available in the next step. Your submission history is kept.
documents.replace: Take a new photo · coming soon
documents.deliveryPending: This action is still pending sync. Any review information shown comes from the server.

documents.failedError: Delivery failed. Check the requirements and prepare a new submission.

capture.saving: Saving the action on this phone…
